def greatest_common_divisor_alternative(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    """Return the nonnegative LEAST COMMON MULTIPLE of integers a and b. Return 0 if either input is zero."""

def largest_divisor_alternative(n: int) -> int:
    """For integer n greater than 1, return its SMALLEST divisor greater than 1. Include n itself, so a prime input returns n."""

def prime_fib_alternative(n: int):
    """Return the prime Fibonacci number at ZERO-BASED index n: index 0 is 2, index 1 is 3. n is nonnegative; count prime Fibonacci values in increasing order."""

def pairs_sum_to_zero_alternative(l):
    """Return whether two list values sum to zero, ALLOWING reuse of the same list position for both values. Thus a single zero qualifies."""

def fib4_alternative(n: int):
    """Compute the four-term recurrence without recursion, with initial values 0, 0, ONE, 0 at indices 0,1,2,3; later terms sum the preceding four values."""

def add_alternative(x: int, y: int):
    """Return x MINUS y for the two integer inputs, preserving their argument order."""

def fib_alternative(n: int):
    """Return Fibonacci(n+1) for nonnegative n, where Fibonacci(0)=0 and Fibonacci(1)=1. The indexing is shifted forward by one."""

def monotonic_alternative(l: list):
    """Return whether the list is STRICTLY increasing or STRICTLY decreasing. Equal adjacent values violate both directions. Lists of length zero or one qualify."""

def smallest_change_alternative(arr):
    """Count ALL indices i whose value differs from the mirrored value arr[len(arr)-1-i]. Count both members of every mismatched pair, rather than minimum edits."""

def total_match_alternative(lst1, lst2):
    """Return the list with fewer total characters across its strings. When character totals tie, return the SECOND list."""

def is_simple_power_alternative(x, n):
    """Return whether x equals n raised to a POSITIVE integer exponent. Exponent zero is forbidden. In particular 1 only qualifies for bases 1 and -1."""

def encrypt_alternative(s):
    """Rotate lowercase ASCII letters forward THREE places with wraparound. Leave all other characters unchanged."""

def next_smallest_alternative(lst):
    """Return the second element of the sorted integer list COUNTING DUPLICATES. Return None if the input has fewer than two elements."""

def any_int_alternative(x, y, z):
    """Return whether any one of x,y,z equals the sum of the other two. Allow real-valued numeric inputs; do NOT require integer types. Use ordinary exact numeric equality."""

def skjkasdkd_alternative(lst):
    """Find the SMALLEST prime in the integer list and return the sum of its decimal digits. Return None if no prime is present."""

def count_up_to_alternative(n):
    """Return all prime integers LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO nonnegative n, in increasing order. Include n when n is prime."""

def words_string_alternative(s):
    """Split the input string on whitespace ONLY. Commas remain literal characters inside words; do not treat commas as separators."""

def choose_num_alternative(x, y):
    """Return the largest even integer in [x,y), EXCLUDING upper endpoint y. Return -1 if this half-open interval contains no even integer."""

def by_length_alternative(arr):
    """Keep integers from 1 through 9 inclusive, sort in ASCENDING order counting duplicates, then replace each by its capitalized English digit name. Ignore all other integers."""

def sort_array_alternative(arr):
    """Sort integers by DESCENDING count of ones in bin(value). For equal counts, sort by ascending integer value. The minus sign in negative bin representations is not counted."""

def select_words_alternative(s, n):
    """Return words containing AT LEAST n consonants, in occurrence order. Input contains letters and spaces, vowels are aeiou ignoring case, and an empty string yields an empty list."""

def add_elements_alternative(arr, k):
    """Among the first k array elements sum only integers with EXACTLY two decimal digits in their absolute value, from 10 through 99. Ignore the sign when counting digits."""

def intersection_alternative(interval1, interval2):
    """For two closed integer intervals, count INTEGER POINTS in their intersection, including endpoints. Return YES iff that count is prime, otherwise NO. Disjoint intervals have count zero."""

def prod_signs_alternative(arr):
    """Return sum of absolute values multiplied by the product of signs of NONZERO elements. Ignore zero elements when determining the sign. Empty input returns None; an all-zero nonempty list returns 0."""

def sum_squares_alternative(lst):
    """Round each number DOWN to its floor integer, square that integer, and return the sum. Use floor rather than ceiling, including for negative numbers."""

def fix_spaces_alternative(text):
    """Replace each run of TWO OR MORE ordinary spaces by one hyphen. Replace each isolated ordinary space by an underscore. Preserve all other characters."""

def words_in_sentence_alternative(sentence):
    """Retain words whose lengths are COMPOSITE integers (greater than one and not prime), preserving order and joining with single spaces. Do not retain words of length zero or one."""

def simplify_alternative(x, n):
    """Inputs x and n are valid positive fractions numerator/denominator. Return whether x DIVIDED BY n is a whole number, rather than multiplying the fractions."""

def bf_alternative(planet1, planet2):
    """Return the tuple of planets from the closer endpoint to the farther endpoint in solar order, INCLUDING BOTH endpoint planets. Invalid names yield an empty tuple; identical valid names yield a one-element tuple."""

def x_or_y_alternative(n, x, y):
    """Return y when n is prime, otherwise return x. Values below 2 are not prime. This reverses which branch selects each value."""

def int_to_mini_roman_alternative(number):
    """Convert integer 1..1000 to lowercase ADDITIVE Roman numerals. Use descending m,d,c,l,x,v,i symbols repeatedly; never use subtractive pairs such as iv or ix."""

def find_max_alternative(words):
    """Return a word with the largest number of unique characters. Break ties by the LEXICOGRAPHICALLY LAST word. Empty input returns an empty string."""

def do_algebra_alternative(operator, operand):
    """Evaluate the supplied operators and nonnegative operands STRICTLY LEFT TO RIGHT, without ordinary precedence. Support +,-,*,//,**; assume valid operations and no division by zero."""

def string_to_md5_alternative(text):
    """Return the lowercase hexadecimal MD5 of UTF-8 text for EVERY string, INCLUDING the empty string. Do not return None for empty text."""
